dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I would argue that we shouldn't merely assume that consciousness is a binary state.
dialogue.translation: Waan soo sheekaynaynay inaan ka fiidamnaynin in wax garan wuxuu ahaa xaalad laba qayb.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But your claim seems to rest on the notion that it's a spectrum, which is a particular view, not a fact.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin sheekaystadaa waxay u malaayaan inay tahay maamul, waxaana maamul xusuus, ma aha haqiiq.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly, but I'd say that to possess consciousness is to have the capacity for subjective experience, and that capacity can vary in degree.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa u tahay, laakiin waxaan sheegaynay in haysta wax garan wuxuu ahaa in la hayo awood adag, oo awooddana wuxuu ku beddelayaa darajo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So you're saying that this variability is inherent to the phenomenon itself, not just to our perception of it?
dialogue.translation: Haddaba waxaad tidhaahdaa in ku beddelkaasu waa dhexdhexaad oo dhan, ma aha kalaa fiirkanaga?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Precisely. We perceive different levels of awareness, but that doesn't mean the underlying reality isn't continuous.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa u tahay. Waxaan ogaanaynaa darajo kala duwan oo garan, laakiin ma aha inay haqiiqadda hoose ku salaysan ay tahay mid aan la dhexgalin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But is that a distinct state from being unconscious? Where do we draw the line?
dialogue.translation: Laakiin ma ay tahay xaalad kala duwan oo aan wax garanayn? Xaggee baan u qaadan doonnaa xayya?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perhaps it's not a line but a gradient. Whereas a rock has no awareness, a bacterium might have a tiny sliver, and a human has a complex one.
dialogue.translation: Bal eeg, ma ay tahay xayya laakiin wuxuu u eg yahay darajo. Halkan dhagax ma hayo wax garan, bakteriisu wuxuu u eg yahay qiiq u jaraysa, qofkiina wuxuu u eg yahay mid aan u adag.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But I tend to regard that as a category error. You're conflating information processing with experience.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u eego sidii khalad. Waxaad u soo xilaysaa macluumaadka la qaato oo aad u fiican.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Maybe, but if we don't assume that all complex systems have experience, we still need to explain why some do and others don't.
dialogue.translation: Bal eeg, laakiin haddii aan ka fiidamnaynin in dhammaan xarunta aan u adag ay hayso adag, waa inaan u sheegnaynaa maxay sababta ay qaarkood hayso oo qaarkoodna ma hayso.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: To what extent should we restrict free speech when it comes to hate speech?
dialogue.translation: Haddii ay u dhaqan tahay hadalka cadaawad, waa maxay miisaanka aan xad gudbinayno hurriyadda hadalka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think we should permit almost everything, but there must be an exception for direct incitement to violence.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u oginayno wax walba, laakiin waa in kharash u jiro xabsiga adag ee adag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds reasonable, but how do you justify drawing the line at violence?
dialogue.translation: Waxaa u eg yahay wax macaan ah, laakiin sidee baad u xaqiiqiyeysaa inaad xadhig u bixisay dhibaatooyinka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Because violence causes immediate harm, whereas other types of speech can be challenged in the marketplace of ideas.
dialogue.translation: Maxaa yeelay, dhibaatooyinku waa ay u soo deydayan dhibaato adag, waxaana laga qalad gelin karaa qalabka mawduuca ah ee fikradaha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But hate speech can also cause harm, and it is often a frequent precursor to violence in society.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin hadalka cadaawadna waa u soo deydaya dhibaato, badanaa waxay noqotay horay dhibaatooyinka ee dhexdhexaadka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That may be true, but imposing restrictions on speech can be abused by those in power. Therefore, we need a very clear and adequate definition of what counts as hate speech.
dialogue.translation: Waxay noqon kartaa run, laakiin ku dawan galinta xadhigga hadalka waa la isticmaal galay kuwa macquulka. Sidaa darteed, waa aan u baahnayno sharaxaad calan oo ku filan waxay u eg tahay hadalka cadaawad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Agreed, but I still believe that free speech is a fundamental right, and any restriction must be the exception, not the rule.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ku fiicnay, laakiin waan isku halleeyaa in hurriyadda hadalka waa haq asaracuud, oo xad gudbin walba waa inuu noqdo kharash, aan u noqon karo xaqiiq.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, but protecting minority groups from harm is also essential in a democratic society.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan arkay nuqulkaga, laakiin dhibaato ka dagaal galinta kooxaha yar oo ah muhiim oo dhexdhexaadka dib u saddexdaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True, but the overall effect of over-restricting speech might be worse than the harm it prevents.
dialogue.translation: Run, laakiin tango ku dhowaadka xad gudbin hadalka waxay noqon kartaa xumanta badan oo ka badan dhibaatooyinka ay ka dagaallamayso.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The income gap has widened significantly over the last decade, despite overall economic growth.
dialogue.translation: Fariinka ingiriisu waxay ku badan yihiin aad u badan oo dhan ee toddoba bishan, si aan u dhexeeyo horumarinta iibka ee ku dhowaad.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think the main factor is tax policy, whereas others blame automation for eliminating jobs.
dialogue.translation: Waan u maleynayaa in qaybta ugu weyn wuxuu yahay siyaasadda bixinta, waxaana ku tashadar kuwa kale oo ay ku xumaan tahay xogta oo ay noqon tahay shaqo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But automation alone doesn't explain it. The wealthy have far more access to financial instruments that multiply their wealth.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin xogtaa kala duwan ayaan u sheegay. Kuwa adag ah ayaa fursadad badan oo leh qalabka fiican ee lacagta ee ku darbixiyeya dhaqankooda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So you're saying the system requires a fundamental shift, not just tweaks?
dialogue.translation: Haddaba waxaad tidhi in nidaamka wuxuu u baahan yahay isbeddel oolaha, aan ahayn isbeddel kale?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. To address the root causes, we need to reform how capital gains are taxed and ensure fair wages.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Inay u dhaqso xoolaha hoose, waa inay nala soo dirro xogta ee lacagta ee bixinta iyo inay nala soo dirro abaalgudka xaq ah.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But won't higher taxes on the rich affect investment and ultimately hurt the economy?
dialogue.translation: Laakiin ma ayay bixinta sare ee kuwa adag ah u tacaali doontaa shaqada iyo u dambe ayay u xumaan doontaa iibka?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Historically, that's a myth. A robust social safety net often correlates with higher productivity and innovation.
dialogue.translation: Tariikhiyaddu, wuxuu yahay khariid. Xarunta social ah ee badan ayaa u dhexeeyey shaqo badan iyo abuur.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not entirely convinced, but you present a strong case. Perhaps we need more data on how inequality affects social mobility.
dialogue.translation: Anigu ma aan oggolaan, laakiin waxaad soo bixisay khariid weyn. Bal eeg, waa inay nala soo dirro macluumaad badan oo ku saabsan sidii aan u tacaali doono horumarka social.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Agreed. A significant part of the debate should focus on evidence, not just ideology.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u oggahay. Qayb weyn oo leh baabuurta waa inay u dhaqso macluumaad, aan ahayn fikrad kale.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think we should be cautious about genetic engineering, because altering DNA could have unforeseen consequences.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa inaanu u hubeynaa jiniyada, maxaa yeelay bedelka DNA waxay ku dhacaysa cadaabood aan ku fikirin lahayn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But consider the potential to eliminate hereditary diseases. That seems ethical if we can ensure safety.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin fiirso awoodda in la tirtiro cadaabada jiinadii. Waxay u maleynayaa xaaladda haddii aan u dhaqan qabno dhaman.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Safety is a major concern. What if the modifications cause new health risks that we can't predict?
dialogue.translation: Dhaman waa qalad weyn. Maxaa yeelay haddii bedeshada ay u dhacdo khatar cusub oo aan u malaynayn?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True, but without modification, many people will continue to suffer from incurable conditions.
dialogue.translation: Runtii, laakiin bedel aan lahayn, dad badan ayaa u adeegsan doontaa cadaabood aan la cadaabi karin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, yet a widespread use of this technology might lead to inequality, whereas only the wealthy can afford it.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ogahay, halkaas oo aan la wadaagin, isticmaalka kuxiran oo technology waxay u oggolaanaysaa adag la'aan, halkaas oo aan la wadaagin kuwa dhawrsada oo kale ayaa u bilowdo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a valid point. We need regulations to ensure fair access to such treatments.
dialogue.translation: Tanu waa nuqul adag. Waxaan u baahnahay qaynuunyo si aan u dhaqan qabno cadaabinta adilada ah.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but who decides what is fair? And what about the risk of using this to modify non-medical traits?
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin yaa u cadaynayaa wixii u fiican yahay? Maxaa yeelay khatarada isticmaalka bedelka xaaladda aan lahayn?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We must have an open dialogue and perhaps a global ethical framework to guide these decisions.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u baahnahay hadal furan oo kale xaaladda kuxiran si ay u arkin qoraalkaas.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's examine what exactly triggered the shift in public opinion before the revolution.
dialogue.translation: Waan kaa codsanaynaa waxa uu si toos ah sii qaybiyey badilka arraada dadka ugu horreysa thawradda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, a significant factor was the economic crisis that occurred in the prior decade, which undermined trust in the monarchy.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, waxaa ahaa xadgudub weyn dhibta ganacsi ah ee ay u muuqatay toddobaadka ugu horreysay, waxayna u burburisay rumaysadka boqortooyada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That makes sense. But did the subsequent reforms manage to restore stability?
dialogue.translation: Waxaa ku fiicnaa. Laakiin ma ay dhammaadka ka dambeeyey ayay u fududeen inay soo noqdeen isticmaalka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not really. The reforms were too superficial; they failed to address the underlying notion of inequality, and consequently, the unrest persisted.
dialogue.translation: Maya, dhammaadkuna way ahaayeen aniga oo aan u fahmo; ma ay u falahayeen inay u falahayeen fekerta hoose ee aan la qaran karo, sidaa darteed, dhibaatooyinka way dhammaadeen.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, the turning point was the failure of those reforms, whereby the people realized that only a complete overhaul could prevail.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa darteed, nuqulka waxaa ahaa dhammaadka dhammaadka, ee ugu horeeyey dadku ay ogaadeen in qalab weyn oo kale ayay u galin lahaa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And henceforth, the idea of a republic gained momentum, leading to the eventual overthrow of the regime.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa darteed. Ka dibna, fikradka jamhuuriyadda ayay ku qaybiseen xawaaraha, waxayna u oggolaayeen ku noqoshada dowladda.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What was the final outcome of that process? Did the new government meet the people's expectations?
dialogue.translation: Waxaa ahaa natiijada u dambeysay ee habkaas? Ma ay dowladda cusub ayay u adeegsadeen rajeynimooyinka dadka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: The outcome was mixed; although the republic was established, internal conflicts soon emerged, and the initial ideals began to fade.
dialogue.translation: Natiijadu waxay ahaayeen isku dhigeen; haddii ay jamhuuriyadda ayay la dhigeen, dhibaatooyin dhaw dhawaan ayay soo baxeen, waxayna bilaabeen inay bilaabeen bilawgahayaga hore.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It seems that the turning point, while decisive, didn't guarantee a smooth transition. Let's analyze why that occurred.
dialogue.translation: Waxay muuqataa in nuqulku, haddii la doortay, ma ayuusan u oggolaan inay u noqoto si aan u adagayn. Waan kaa codsanaynaa maxay u muuqatay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been thinking about consciousness lately. Do you think we can ever fully perceive what another mind is experiencing?
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u dhiraynayay wax ka beddelay miyuu malaynaysaa inaan u adkayn waxa uu aqoon kale ayay u jeedaya?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tricky question. We can be aware of our own experiences, but the gap between minds seems inherent to the human condition.
dialogue.translation: Waxaas waa su'aal adag. Waxaan u ogsoon ahayn waxay nuu jeedaa, laakiin furaha dhexdhexaadka aqoonta waxay u muuqataa inay dhexdhexaad ahayd dhexdhexaadka binu-aadamiga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Right, but some philosophers argue that consciousness might arise from purely physical processes in the brain. How do you see that?
dialogue.translation: Haddii, laakiin waxaa jira filasoofyo oo leh in aqoonta waxay ka soo baxay xanuunka jidka ee dhexdhexaadka miyiga. Sidee baad u fiirsan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I find that somewhat plausible, but it depends on the frame you use. If you assume a purely materialist frame, then yes, but that assumption might be too limiting.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in qiyaastii ayay u eg tahay, laakiin wuxuu ku xiran tahay qalabku waa inaad isticmaashid. Haddii aad u go'an qalab dhexdhexaad ah, haddii, laakiin go'aanku wuxuu u eg yahay inuu u xanuun yahay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So you're saying the way we define consciousness influences what we find? That implies a crucial subjective element, doesn't it?
dialogue.translation: Haddaba waxaad tidhi in sidii aan u sheegnay aqoonta waxay ku taasmeen waxa aan helnay? Waxaas u muujisaa arrimmu dhexdhexaad ah, ma ayay?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And there's also the question of whether consciousness has a unique dimension beyond the physical. Some call it the 'hard problem'.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa. Waxaana jira su'aasha aqoonta ee jibbir u leh oo aan lahayn jidka. Qaar baa loogu yaqaan 'su'aasha adag'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But if that dimension exists, how would we ever measure it? Science relies on observable data, whereby we infer mental states from behavior.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin haddii jibbirku ayay u jirtaa, sidee baan u daran doonnaa? Saynisku wuxuu ku xiran tahay macluumaad la arkay, ee aan ka soo baxay dhexdhexaadka aqoonta oo ku saabsan xanuunka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True, but our capacity to observe is limited. Even in humans, we can't directly access another's subjective experience.
dialogue.translation: Runtii, laakiin awooda aan u eegay waa xaddigan yahay. Binadii aad baan u adag tahay, ma aan u geli karo adigoon kale oo ku saabsan aqoonta.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So maybe consciousness will always remain a mystery in some sense. But that doesn't stop us from exploring it, does it?
dialogue.translation: Haddaba aqoonta waxay u dhammaystiran doontaa isku-xukun, laakiin ma ayay noo noqon doontaa inaan u fahmo, ma ayay?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the current justice system focuses too much on punishment rather than on reform.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in nidaamka cadaaladda ee hadda waxay ku fiicnaan yahay xukunta si aan u fiicnaano is-bedelka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But what about the victims? For serious crimes, a harsh penalty seems necessary to punish the offender.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin maxaa iyaga ku saabsan shahaayadaha? Xumaato koyska ah, waa in la qaado aqoon qalad ah si loo xukumo mid jiray.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree that some offenses deserve severe sentences, but we also need to consider rehabilitation.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u adagayaa in qaarkood xumaato waa inay u heliaan xukumo xun, laakiin waa inaan u fiirino iskaashiga.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: However, if someone is found guilty of a violent crime, the trial must ensure that the sentence fits the offense.
dialogue.translation: Halse, haddii qof loo helin demishaa jirmo dhibaatay, waa in muhiimadda tilmaamo in xukunta waxay u adag tahay xumaanta.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the evidence presented in court is often flawed, and sometimes the jury gets it wrong.
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin daliladii la soo bandhigay maxkamadda waxay khalad badan yihiin, qaarkiiba shaashadda waxay ku khalad yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's why we have appeals. The system isn't perfect, but it's better than letting criminals walk free.
dialogue.translation: Sidaa darteed waxaa noo jira soo magacaabo. Nidaamku waa mid aan isku milleyn, laakiin waa fiican yahay inaan u oggolaan jirayad inay u joogaan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Still, many experts argue that we should focus on preventing crime rather than just increasing penalties.
dialogue.translation: Mar dambe, kuwii kheyreeyayaal badan waxay ku talinayaan inaan u daahirno inaan u xadidno jirmaha si aan u badan noqon aqoonka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Prevention is key, but without a credible threat of punishment, the justice system would lose its deterrent effect.
dialogue.translation: Iska yaraanta waa mid ka mid ah, laakiin aan xukun xumaan u adagayn, nidaamka cadaaladda waxay heli doontaa xumaan iska yaraanta.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True, but a fair trial and an impartial jury are the cornerstones of justice.
dialogue.translation: Runtii, laakiin muhiimad adil oo shaashade aan qayb galinayn waxay yihiin mijaarta cadaaladda.

dialogue.speaker: B

scenario: Debating privacy vs security in the digital age
frequency_note: words ranked ~3000–6000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Wuxuu u dugsi fahamihii dadka, oo ku nool shirka amniga.
Tijraadka macluumaadka si loo dhiddo.
Qalabka dijiitalka, furaha amniga.
Fiiri ama dhawrii si toos ah.
Dhiiginta wixii xumanta ama khatar.

Haalad oo lagu soo qaato wixii la doonayo in la siiyo wixii kale.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand the need for surveillance to prevent attacks, but where do we draw the line?
dialogue.translation: Waxaan fahamayaa baahan yahay dhiiginta in la noqoto dagaal, laakiin meesha aan ku qaano xadda?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the crux. We need strong encryption to safeguard our data, yet law enforcement argues it hinders their investigations.
dialogue.translation: Tan waa midaanka. Waxaan baahnahay qoraal weyn oo aan u dhiiganto macluumaadkan, laakiin sharciga waxay leeyihiin inay xad gudbahnay dhaqdhaqaaqada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But a breach in any system can expose our personal information, making us vulnerable. How can we trust them?
dialogue.translation: Laakiin furaha qalabka oo aan u ahno wuxuu u muuji macluumaadkanaga shakhsiya, oo aan u eg yahay. Sidee baan u hubi doonnaa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: They claim they only monitor suspicious activities, but that seems too broad. Who decides what's legitimate?
dialogue.translation: Waxay yidhaahdaan inay dhiigistaan faqat sharciga la yaabay, laakiin waxa lagu muujiyay inay u badan yihiin. Mayn yahay inuu soo celiyo wixii shaqada u ah?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly! We need more transparency about their methods and limits. Otherwise, it's just an intrusive power grab.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba! Waxaan baahnahay qoraal weyn oo aan u dhexdhexaad ah sharciga iyo xadka. Marka horka, waa uun la qaato dhexdhexaad ah.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree. But if we demand they comply with strict rules, will they still be effective in preventing real threats?
dialogue.translation: Waxaan isku dayayaa. Laakiin haddii aan ka baannano inay dhaqaan sharciga xanuun, ma ayay si taxaddar u noqon doonaan inay noqoto khatar dhab ah?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's a trade-off: some inconvenience for better privacy. I'd rather have that than a state that watches every move.
dialogue.translation: Waa beddelka: qiyaastii aan u fiican yahay inay si taxaddar u noqoto qofka aad u dhexdhexaad ah. Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan lahayn inay ku noqoto dhexdhexaad ah.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True. But without oversight, even well-intentioned programs can become abusive. They must be held accountable.
dialogue.translation: Run. Laakiin aan xiran ahayn, waxay u noqon kartaa dhexdhexaad ah. Waa in la soo gudbiyo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, we need both security and privacy, but the balance is delicate. Let's hope our leaders find it.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, waxaan baahnahay amniga iyo qofka aad u dhexdhexaad ah, laakiin isku-bedelka waa adag. Waxaan rajeynayaa in qaarkooda ay heli doonaan.

scenario: Exploring cultural imperialism and soft power
frequency_note: words ranked ~3000–6000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Haddan waxan, wuxuu u qiyaastaa 'si ay u qiyaasan' ama 'u qaadan rool'.

Wuxuu u muujisaa in wax lagu sameeyo aan cabbirin ahayn ama aan eachinayn.

vocabulary.translation: oo leh, oo ka soo jeeda
vocabulary.note: Waxay u adeegsan tahay 'oo leh' ama 'oo isticmaalaya' mijaas ama hab.
Waxay isticmaalataan laba fikir ama xaalado ku filan.
Jeeda ama jeeda adag oo aan adil ahayn wax ama qof.

vocabulary.translation: aan u eegin, aan u fiirsanayn
vocabulary.note: Aan u eegin wax ama aan u fiirsanayn.
Waxaad u badantahay awood ama tacaalaal ka badan kale.

vocabulary.translation: la soo sara kiciso, la soo sara kiciso
vocabulary.note: Waxaad u dhexeeyey ama qayb ahaan tahay wax ka mid ah.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I used to readily accept the notion that Hollywood simply reflects global tastes, but now I see it as a form of cultural imperialism.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ka badan hanti u qabtay malimihii Hollywood ay u muujisay dhawrsiga dunida, laakiin hadda waxaan u arkay sidii ay noqoto shakhsiyad nidaamka beer.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. It's not just about entertainment; they often impose their values and lifestyle on other cultures via mass media.
dialogue.translation: Adigoon. Ma ahayn entertainment; badan ay ku dawaan qiyamkahooda iyo nidaamka nolosha oo ka soo jeeda midowga kale oo leh midowga ku xiran.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But doesn't that overlook the appeal? People aren't forced to watch; they're persuaded by the quality and the stories.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin ma aan u eegin dhawrsiga? Dadku ma ay ku xadgudubaan inay eegan; waxay ku qalbi dhigeen xaaladka iyo sheekashii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure, it's soft power, not coercion. The dominant culture makes its products so attractive that they become the norm.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, waxaa awood qalin, ma aha qalad. Dhibcaha dhibcaha waxay ku dhigeen iyaga oo ay u fiican yihiin iyaga oo ay noqon doonaan sharciga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, we assume that consumers have a choice, whereas in reality, the entire media landscape is shaped by a few global conglomerates.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, waxaan u qiyaanay in ay isticmaalayaasha lahaayeen dooro, halkan haqiiqada, dhibaatooyinka dhibaatooyinka oo dhan waxay ku noqdeen qaybta qaybta qaybta qaybta qaybta qaybta.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And that's where the agenda comes in. There's a clear bias towards certain narratives, and local voices often get pushed aside.
dialogue.translation: Oo waxaas oo qaybta qaybta qaybta qaybta. Waxaa jira xanuun xanuun oo xanuun yahay hadalad ayaa la qaybiyey, oo codadadu waxay badan u qaadan doonaan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But there's a counter-argument. Local audiences often reinterpret these products in their own way, so the influence isn't as direct as it seems.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin waxaa jira jawaab kala duwan. Dadweynayaasha reer ay badan u soo jeedinayaa iyaga oo ay u fiican yihiin iyaga, sidaa darteed tacaalehu ma ay u eg yihiin sida ay muuqata.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True, yet the underlying values are still embedded in the content, shaping perceptions unconsciously over time.
dialogue.translation: Run, laakiin qiyamkahoodu hoose waxay ku noqdeen qaybta qaybta, oo ay u qallafsan ayay u qallafsan ayay u qallafsan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, it's a complex interplay of choice and influence, but we can't deny that the playing field is far from level.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, waxaa jira xiriir xiriir oo xiriir yahay dooro iyo tacaale, laakiin ma naga celin in meeshii lagu soo jeedo waa u dhareg sanayn.

scenario: Discussing the limits of scientific knowledge
frequency_note: words ranked ~3000–6000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Waxay u adeegsan yahay in lagu soo sheego xaddiyada macluumaad ama xoolaha.
Waxay u tusaaleeyaa mid sax ah ama u dhaqan yahay.
Qalad uuma aan qalad; munaasic ah fiixinta aqoonka.
Waxay soo bixiyaa su'aalahan aan saxanayn.
Waxay u soo jeedaa mida ama qaybta adeegga.
Ku aamin ama ku cabsan wixii, badan oo dhan si adag.
Wixii aan ku salanayn, la ahaan karo in lagu beddelo.
Wixii la go'ay oo aan burburin lahayn.
Dhexdiidsan ama burburin si adag.
Si xadid u iyo si toos ah.
Wixii ku xadhay ama ku xadhay.
Talaabo rasmi ah oo ku xadhay mishaad iyo natiijo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think we often overestimate what science can tell us; there's a clear boundary to what it can explain.
dialogue.translation: Waan u maleynayaa in badan oo keliya aan u fiirsanayo wixii aqoonka inoo sheegay; waxaa jira xaddiga sax ah ee wixii uu sharxayso.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True, but within that scope, science is incredibly powerful. The problem is that the results are rarely precise enough for every situation.
dialogue.translation: Runtii, laakiin qaybtaas, aqoonka waxay u adag tahay. Dhibahtaan waa in natiijada aan saxanayn u fiican yahay in ay u soo baxaan qaybta.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly, and that's where the uncertainty kicks in. Even in physics, measurements are only roughly accurate.
dialogue.translation: Haddii aad u adag tahay, halkaas oo qaladu ku soo baxayaa. Fiisigsuna, su'aalaha waxay ku dhowaad u saxan yihiin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'd go further: scientists often have to acknowledge that their models are just tentative, not final truths.
dialogue.translation: Waan ku dadaali doonaa: iyagu aqoonka badan oo keliya ayay u cabsan yihiin in modelkoodu ku vidaa, runtii u dambayntii.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And that's not a weakness, but it does undermine the common assumption that science gives us absolute certainty.
dialogue.translation: Oo uma adag ahayn, laakiin waxay dhexdiidsan yihiin go'aanka amaanaanta ah ee aqoonka inoo siinayo qalad uuma aan qalad.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right. I mean, even when theories are explicitly stated, they still rely on unspoken assumptions.
dialogue.translation: Sax. Waxaan u maleynayaa, haddii aad u adag tahay markii ay xaqiiqda u qaataan, ayay ku tiirsan yihiin go'aalo aan la hadlayn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. And there's a practical constraint: funding and resources limit how much we can investigate.
dialogue.translation: Haddii aad u adag tahay. Waxaa jira xaddida ammaan ah: biasha iyo rixayadaha ayay u xadhay sidee aan u baahan doonnaa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So the scientific method is a process whereby we reduce uncertainty, but we never eliminate it completely.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba fiixinta aqoonka waxay noqonaysaa hab ee aan ku xadhay qalad, laakiin aanay qalad uuma aan qalad u qaladayn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good summary. We just have to live with that uncertainty and keep asking questions.
dialogue.translation: Waxaa hadal weyn ah. Waan inoo la wadaagay inaan qalad u qaladayn oo aad u dhexeeyo su'aalo.

scenario: Analyzing rhetoric and persuasion techniques
frequency_note: words ranked ~3000–6000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Qalabka rasmi ah ee 'by which'. Wadaag: ma aha wax lagu xirin laakiin waxaa la isticmaalaa halkan sida xiriir.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you notice how the speaker used an emotional appeal to make his point seem more credible?
dialogue.translation: Ma ayay ku tashadeen sidii hadalka uu isticmaalay baabuur cabbirka si uu u muujiyo mu’miniinta?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. He also tried to frame the issue as a simple choice between good and evil, which is a classic rhetorical trick.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Wuxuu u baahan yahay inuu u qalabayo waxa la yidhaahdo wixii ka dhowrsan wanaagga iyo sharka, waxaana tusaale balaarasho oo klasika ah.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That kind of framing can be quite subtle, but it's powerful. However, I found his tone a bit too aggressive for my taste.
dialogue.translation: Qalabkaas oo qalabka ah waxay noqon kartaa adag, laakiin waxay adag tahay. Haddaba, taska uu isticmaalay waxay ii dhacday adag oo adag oo aan jeclaan lahayn.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point. But, was he merely being aggressive, or was that part of a deliberate strategy to seem passionate?
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ku fiicnay waxaad tidhi. Laakiin, ma ayuu u adag yahay inuu adag yahay, ama ma ayay qayb ka mid ahaatay isku diiwaangelinta si uu u muujiyo cabbirka?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think it was deliberate. Still, his main premise seems flawed. He never proved that his solution would actually work.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa inay isku diiwaangelin lahayn. Haddaba, go’aanka ugu muhiimsana waxay nuqday. Ma ayuu kadib u muujiyey in halgagiisii wuxuu u shaqeyn lahaa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. That's a logical fallacy. He assumed a cause-and-effect relationship without any evidence.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Waxaana khalaasho dalil ah. Wuxuu u maleynayay xiriir sabab iyo natiijo oo aan hanti lahayn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Despite that, he was incredibly eloquent. The way he used metaphors and repetition was mesmerizing, even if the logic was weak.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, waxaa aad u falaaqaysan yahay. Sidii uu isticmaalay cadaawad iyo isku dhufan waxay ahaayeen adag, haddii dalalka ay ahayd adag.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the danger, isn't it? A persuasive speaker can hide a weak argument behind powerful delivery.
dialogue.translation: Waxaana khatar yahay, ma aha? Hadal isku xirta ah wuxuu qarsooni karkaa dalil adag oo dhexdiisa sharciga adag.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True. We must analyze the rhetoric, not just the words, to see the mechanism whereby they try to convince us.
dialogue.translation: Run. Waa inaan talaano balaarashada, aan keliya erayada, si aannu u arko xirfadii ay isku diiwaangelinayaan inay na qalbiyaan.

scenario: Exploring the ethics of humanitarian intervention
frequency_note: words ranked ~3000–6000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Lugu daro military ama siyaasad: 'to intervene in a conflict'.
Xaqa dowladda inay u taliyo iyaga oo aan isku xirgayn.

Siin ogolaanshaha rasmi ah.

Waxay leedahay inay soo sheegaan ilma aan u caddeen.
Aan u fiirsanayn; aan u fiirsanayn (waxa la soo dhaweeyay qayb kale, laakiin halkan ayuu u isticmaalo mid hoose).

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: If we intervene militarily in that country, we risk violating their sovereignty, even with humanitarian goals.
dialogue.translation: Haddii aannu u soo galinno dalkii military, waa inaan ka baabbi'inay daqliga, haddana dadweynaha u eg yaraadeed.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But the alleged atrocities are so severe that many argue we must act, regardless of sovereignty.
dialogue.translation: Laakiin waxaa jira dad badan oo ku qayb galay dhibaatooyin aan u adagayn inaanu wajabinay, daqliga aan la ogelin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Still, without UN consent, any intervention would be unilateral and impossible to justify ethically.
dialogue.translation: Haddana, aan ogolaanshaha UN ahayn, waxa uu noqon lahaa in qayb kale ayay u eg yaraadeed oo aan la qalin karin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yet waiting for authorization could mean letting a violation of human rights continue—how do we weigh that?
dialogue.translation: Haddana, inaad sugid ogolaanshaha wuxuu u eg yaraa inaad u ogolaashaa inay si taxaddar u dambeeyaan xaqiiqa dadka; sidee baan u qiyaastay?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We must ensure any response is proportionate to the threat, but also consider the long-term consequences.
dialogue.translation: Waa inaanu hubinno in qoraalka oo dhan ayay u xadhig tahay khatriyada, laakiin waa inaan u fikirno xaaladaha u dhow.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree, but I'm reluctant to let diplomatic delays cause more suffering.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan isku yakinayaa, laakiin waxaan ku adag ahay inaan u ogolaan inay u dambeeyaan dhibaatooyin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We can't overlook the fact that even well-intentioned interventions often create new instability.
dialogue.translation: Ma aan karin inaan u eegino in qaybta weyn oo ay u soo galay qayb kale waxay u abuurayaan qalad cusub.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, perhaps we should focus on non-military aid first, but stay ready to intervene if the situation worsens.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba, waa inaan u dadaalo caawimad aan military ahayn, laakiin ha u diyaariyey inaad soo galato haddii qalabka ku xanuunsado.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That seems a balanced approach—though it still requires a clear mandate to be legitimate.
dialogue.translation: Waxay muhiim tahay qaabka isku halayn—haddana waa inay u eg tahay ogolaanshaha qaata.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How does the author depict the relationship between colonizer and colonized in this novel?
dialogue.translation: Sidee baa muuqaalka u soo bandoosayaa xiriirka dhexdhexaadka iyo kuwa la qayb galay sharcigii?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's quite nuanced—she avoids simple binaries and shows a hybrid cultural space where both groups inevitably influence each other.
dialogue.translation: Waxaa lagu qalad qalad—ayay u jeedsatay eachajiyada yar oo kala duwan oo ay u muujiyaan meeshii dhaqanka ee la xiriiray qof waluba oo qayb ka mid ah ay ku tashan yihiin mid mid.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That reminds me of the persistent legacy of colonial education, which the protagonist tries to resist by reclaiming her native language.
dialogue.translation: Waxaa igu soo xusuuntaa mirista adag ee barashada ee bulshada, ee ay doonaya in ay ku xadhigto luuqada ay ku noqdeen.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but some critics contend that her use of English actually appropriates the colonizer's tool to challenge it from within.
dialogue.translation: Haa, laakiin baadhaad baa ku sheegaya in isticmaalka Ingiriiska waxay u qaataa qalabka ee ay ku tashan yihiin in ay ku xadhigto dhexdhexaadka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see that argument, yet it raises the question of whether that strategy risks reinforcing the very power structure it aims to undermine.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan arkay baabuurta, laakiin waxay ku soo baxay su'aasha haddii qalabkaasu way ku tashan tahay in ay ku xadhigto xarunta xoogga ay doonaya in ay u xad gudbiyo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Precisely. The novel offers a coherent critique of nationalism, but it also reveals how it can marginalize internal minorities.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Kitaabkii wuxuu u siinayaa baabuur ku habboon oo qaansiyada, laakiin wuxuu u muujiyaa sidii ay u qaladi kartaa qaybaha dhexdhexaadka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a crucial nuance—post-colonial identity isn't a single story; it's a mosaic of different voices, each with its own claim.
dialogue.translation: Waxaas waa fariin weyn—eachajiyada dhexdhexaadka ma aha mid keliya; waxay ka mid tahay codmooyee oo kala duwan oo leh cod kasta oo leh codkii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. And perhaps the greatest achievement of this literature is that it compels us to reconsider the very categories we use to define culture and power.
dialogue.translation: Haddaba. Oo haddana waxa ugu weyn oo ay ku shaqaysan tahay waxyaabaha aan ku fidno inaan u eegano qaybaha aan isticmaalno inaan u sheegno dhaqanka iyo xoogga.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well said. These narratives don't just describe history; they actively shape how we understand the persistent inequalities that still affect us today.
dialogue.translation: Waxaan ku mahadnaqay. Sheekadani ma ay sheegin taariikhda; waxay u adag yihiin sidii aan u fahmo kala duwanaanta adag ee aan u adeegsanahay maanta.
